integrity: The exact stratum is proved by a free 2-step quotient classification and Fraïssé homogeneity. The complete-profile statement is a rigorous two-sided asymptotic bound; finite computations are consistency checks only.
scientific_limitations: Only the level-1 independent stratum has an exact Galois-number orbit formula. For all tuples the result is the leading logarithmic asymptotic, not an exact profile. Galois numbers and the free-algebra model V plus exterior-square are prior.
title: Quartic orbit growth in the generic 2-nilpotent Lazard Lie algebra
